summary: Four Progress bars at 60% showing size sm (4px), size md (6px) and the default lg (8px), plus an indeterminate sm bar.
use: Picking the bar thickness: thin bars for dense cards and headers, the default 8px elsewhere.
spec: `<Progress value={60} label="Default bar" />` keeps the 8px height
`<Progress indeterminate size="sm" label="Small indeterminate bar" />` honours the height too
Stacked in a grid with `gap: var(--ca-space-4)`, `max-width: 360px`
